column1: # Agent CLIs that `ultron agent` knows. Tab-separated columns:
# mise-tool: what `mise use -g` installs ("-" = installed some other way).
# guide: where the agent reads global instructions, so it learns about ultron:
#   skills:DIR  reads skills from DIR (the ultron skill is linked as DIR/ultron)
#   link:DIR    DIR becomes a link to ~/.agents/skills/ultron
#   block:FILE  FILE gets a short ultron block between <!-- ultron:begin --> and <!-- ultron:end -->
# Your own ~/.config/ultron/agents.tsv has the same columns, is read after this file and wins by name.
# The mise tools below are mise's own registry names (`mise registry`), so mise picks the install method
# each vendor supports (claude and codex as native binaries, gemini and opencode through npm).
